en.headline: Sixth direct university admission scheme opens in October
en.dek: Local Secondary Six students sitting the 2027 DSE can be nominated from 7 October, with more than 300 publicly funded programmes taking part across the eight UGC universities.
body: The Education Bureau said on Thursday that nominations for the sixth School Nominations Direct Admission Scheme will run from 7 October to 2 December 2026. The scheme is open to local Secondary Six students sitting the 2027 Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education Examination and starting an undergraduate degree that September.

Each local secondary school may nominate two students with exceptional talent and interest in a specific discipline. Each nominee may apply for one designated University Grants Committee-funded bachelor’s programme. Participating universities will interview every nominee and issue firm offers before the 2027 DSE results are released.

The eight UGC-funded universities have designated more than 300 publicly funded undergraduate programmes for the sixth cohort and set admission criteria that are not based on DSE scores. An Education Bureau spokesman said the scheme, launched in the 2022-23 academic year, is meant to recognise abilities that the public examination may not fully capture and to match students with courses that fit their strengths.

Nominees must still apply through the Joint University Programmes Admissions System and sit the DSE as usual, the bureau said, so that other routes remain open. The scheme grew out of a 2020 curriculum review recommendation that the government accepted.

zh.headline: 第六屆學校推薦直接錄取計劃十月接受提名
zh.dek: 教育局公布，應考2027年文憑試的本地中六生可由10月7日起獲校方提名，八所教資會大學提供逾300個公幣資助學士課程。
body: 教育局周四宣布，第六屆學校推薦直接錄取計劃的提名期由2026年10月7日開放至12月2日。計劃供將應考2027年香港中學文憑考試、並於同年9月升讀學士課程的本地中六學生參加。
每間本地中學可推薦兩名在個別學科或範疇具特殊才華及興趣的學生，每名獲推薦學生只可報讀一個指定的教資會資助學士課程。參與大學會為所有獲推薦學生安排面試，並在2027年文憑試成績公布前發出直接錄取通知。
八所教資會資助大學已指定超過300個公幣資助學士課程參與本屆計劃，並為個別課程訂下不以文憑試成績為基礎的收生準則。教育局發言人表示，計劃自2022／23學年推行，旨在認同未必能透過文憑試全面評核的過人才能，讓學生與切合潛能的課程配對。
局方強調，獲推薦學生仍須一如其他中六生經大學聯合招生辦法報讀課程，並如期應考文憑試，以免限制其他升學途徑。計劃源於2020年學校課程檢討專責小組的建議，其後獲教育局接納。
